gen-gf-noto-sans-mongolian-fs-literata: Friendly and modern, Noto Sans Mongolian flares the ends of its s like a pen lifting off. And Literata brings the bookish serif counterweight, sturdy thin lines against slightly heavier thick ones.
gen-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue-fs-literata: Literata is a serif with sturdy hairlines and curves that stay wide open, a bookish voice with some backbone. Noto Sans New Tai Lue gapes generously up top, while Literata holds the line below.
gen-gf-noto-sans-nko-fs-literata: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide, gives Noto Sans NKo its clean, contemporary look, with curves only slightly heavier than the joins. Literata, a text serif, would carry paragraphs gently.
gen-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined-fs-literat: Literata reads as a bookish, sophisticated classic serif, its thin strokes respectable and its rounded letters left unclosed. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined opens its curves like a jar lid; Literata does the steady, wordy work.
gen-gf-noto-sans-shavian-fs-literata: Literata is bookish and sturdy. Noto Sans Shavian lets its a breathe at the bottom, and the text serif follows with moderate stroke contrast, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-noto-serif-hk-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous room where its curves meet the stem. Noto Serif HK counters with a literary, traditional voice, its modest thick-thin contrast and widely parted s giving the pair real range.
gen-gf-noto-serif-jp-fs-bespoke-sans: Glass-clear gaps between terminal and stroke mark Noto Serif JP, a literary serif with moderate stress. Bespoke Sans keeps its sharp curves spaced out, so a long read stays crisp.
gen-gf-noto-serif-khitan-small-script-fs: A mellow range of stroke weights gives Noto Serif Khitan Small Script its literary, faintly modulated line, steady but never stiff. Bespoke Sans brings sharper, low-contrast sans lines, and that difference is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-noto-serif-kr-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and editorial, Noto Serif KR varies its stroke weight only a little, with round letters that look cupped, not clenched. Bespoke Sans then handles the quiet work, a sharp sans with generous space at its curve ends.
gen-gf-noto-serif-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Classic and dignified, Noto Serif SC keeps its s and c uncrowded, with strokes that taper only slightly. Bespoke Sans sits beside it with low contrast, while the serif earns its keep in big, short headings.
